settings.title: Lychee Honey
settings.text:
Floral & Fruity
Delicate floral sweetness with subtle tropical notes. Perfect for breakfast, fruit, yoghurt and drinks.

settings.title: Wild Fennel Honey
settings.text:
Botanical & Aromatic
Smooth and aromatic with delicate herbal and anise-like notes. Ideal for tea, cheese, dressings and cooking.

settings.title: Sesame Honey
settings.text:
Rich & Nutty
Rich and distinctive with toasted, nutty notes and a smooth sweetness. Perfect for marinades, dressings, Asian-inspired dishes and baking.

settings.title: Yellow Mustard Honey
settings.text:
Floral & Gently Warming
Smooth floral sweetness with a distinctive, gently warming character. Perfect for glazes, dressings, roast dishes and savoury recipes.

settings.title: Golden Nut Honey
settings.text:
Rich & Indulgent
A luxurious combination of golden honey, nuts and dried fruit with wonderful texture and richness. Delicious with breakfast, cheese or desserts.

settings.title: Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey
settings.text:
Complex & Floral
A beautifully complex honey with rich floral, herbal and subtly spiced notes. Ideal for breakfast, drinks, cooking and everyday enjoyment.

settings.title: Kashmiri Acacia Honey
settings.text:
Light & Delicate
Mild, smooth and softly floral. A versatile honey for breakfast, baking, drinks and everyday sweetness.

settings.heading: Need a little inspiration?
settings.text: Not sure which honey is right for you? Discover flavours and uses in our Honey Guide, then explore delicious food combinations in our Honey Pairing Guide.

settings.heading: About our brand
settings.text: BeeBlend is the epitome of refined sweetness — where rare, single-origin honeys meet impeccable purity. Each jar is curated for connoisseurs who value elegance, craft, and the finest natural indulgence
